items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps oily, sensitive-feeling skin clean without stripping it while it adjusts to retinol.
The lower 0.3% retinol is a gentle starting strength for softening the look of fine lines.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's comfort and moisture while retinol is introduced.
Mineral SPF 50 is needed every morning with retinol and tends to feel gentler on sensitive-feeling skin.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night on dry skin 2 nights a week, followed by moisturizer, then build up slowly as skin feels comfortable. Wear the SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors, and pause the retinol if skin feels irritated.
